display-body.purpose: Display and body in one corporate-tech voice. Weights 400-800; headings 800 with -0.03em tracking; body 400 at 1rem / 1.5. No other face carries prose.

data.purpose: Fiscal and data figures only — monetary values, SKUs, dates, table cells, metric values, fiscal chips. Tabular numbers and slashed zero via font-feature-settings. Never decorative.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Panels and cards in light theme. Soft, low offset.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Auth card and elevated surfaces in light theme.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Console card on the landing hero.

motion.name: count-up
motion.value: rAF easeOutExpo over 1400ms; data-count-to / data-count-decimals / data-count-prefix; es-VE toLocaleString
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: hero metrics count up like a live console on load. Killed by prefers-reduced-motion (instant final value).

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.value: @keyframes livePulse on opacity of --live-ring; 2.4s ease-out infinite
motion.purpose: Pulsing ring behind the En operación status dot. Killed by prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.value: transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease
motion.purpose: Color cross-fade when toggling dark/light. Killed by prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: The owner's action. Forest green ground with white label; hover darkens to --primary-strong; trailing arrow slides 4px. Radius 12px, focus ring 3px.
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.4rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-ink); font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 8px); border: 1px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-cta:hover { background: var(--primary-strong); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring); } .ds-cta-arrow { font-family: var(--mono); transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Ghost CTA
components.description: Secondary action. Surface ground, border hairline, forest text; hover raises border to --border-strong. Radius 12px.
components.css: .ds-cta-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.4rem; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 8px); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-cta-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); } .ds-cta-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring); }

components.name: Nav Pill
components.description: Top-bar control. Full pill (999px), hairline border, soft text; hover to primary. Radius 999px.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-soft); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-pill:hover { color: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring); }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: 2.5rem circular control in the top bar. Sun shows in dark (click to go light), moon in light. Persists to localStorage 'tetra-theme'; default follows prefers-color-scheme. Inline head script sets data-theme before paint to avoid flash.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--topbar-bg); color: var(--text-soft); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { color: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); } :root:not([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-icon-sun, :root[data-theme="dark"] .ds-icon-moon { display: none; }

components.name: Console Card
components.description: The signature component: the live operations console on the landing hero. Surface card, radius 16px, shadow-lg, hairline-separated metric grid, weekly activity bars, recent movements, live En operación pill with pulsing dot, fiscal chips.
components.html:
Panel de operaciones

En operación
Ventas de hoy0+12% vs ayer
Caja de hoy0+8% vs ayer
components.css: .ds-console-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 16px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(22, 35, 27, 0.10), 0 14px 40px rgba(22, 35, 27, 0.12); overflow: hidden; } .ds-console-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-console-title { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--text-soft); } .ds-live-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-live-dot { width: 0.45rem; height: 0.45rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--live); } .ds-live-dot.pulse { animation: livePulse 2.4s ease-out infinite; } .ds-console-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1px; background: var(--border); } .ds-metric { background: var(--surface); padding: 1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-metric-label { display: block; font-size: 0.68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--text-faint); margin-bottom: 0.35rem; } .ds-metric-value { display: block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 600; font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1, "zero" 1; color: var(--text); } .ds-metric-trend { font-size: 0.7rem; } .ds-metric-trend.up { color: var(--primary); } .ds-metric-trend.warn { color: var(--amber-deep); }

narrative.overview: Tetra's visual world is a real-time operations console for the Venezuelan PyME. Forest green is the healthy operational state — stock present, sale recorded, money counted. Corporate trust comes from a precise banking-grade data grid; the most up to date tech signal comes from live animated figures. Light theme is the paperwork day; dark theme is the operations floor (system default, persisted toggle). The page runs the owner's business live in front of her: Tu negocio, en vivo. The committed direction, lifted from the HTML comment in templates/welcome.html, is the binding thesis: Tetra is the living console of the Venezuelan PyME — a real-time operations floor where green means the business is alive. OWN-WORLD: Forest-green operations system, Sora in a single corporate-tech voice, IBM Plex Mono only for fiscal/data figures, soft offset shadows, 12-16px card radii, hairline data-grid separators, one authored moment (hero metrics count up).
keyCharacteristics: Green is the health signal, not the brand tint. Forest green (#1d6e42 light / #3aa572 dark) marks primary actions, live status, and healthy trends. It means: stock present, sale recorded, money counted.
Two typefaces, two jobs. Sora carries display and body in one corporate-tech voice; IBM Plex Mono carries only fiscal and data figures (tabular numbers, slashed zero). No overlap.
Theme as time of day. Light = paperwork day, dark = operations floor. System default with a persisted manual toggle.
Trust from the grid. Hairline separators and tabular mono figures make the console read as precise and banking-grade, not decorative.
One authored moment. The hero metrics count up like a live console on load; the En operación dot pulses. Everything else is hover state, and prefers-reduced-motion kills it all.
Spanish-first, es-VE. All copy is Spanish. No translation artefacts.

rules.name: The Data-Mono Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is fiscal data, not costume. If a string has no number, date, or figure, it is Sora. Metric values, table cells, SKUs, monetary figures are mono; prose and labels are Sora.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No kicker, eyebrow, or section number above a heading. Sora 800 at clamp(2.6rem, 5.2vw, 4rem) carries the weight on its own.

rules.name: The Elevation Rule
rules.body: Depth is a soft shadow, never a hard offset block. Border XOR heavy shadow — a card carries a hairline border or a shadow, not both stacked.

rules.name: The Rounded Console Rule
rules.body: 8px controls, 12px cards, 16px feature cards, 999px pills. Small 3px rounding is reserved for chart-bar tops. No hard 90° corners.

rules.name: The Green-Health Rule
rules.body: Forest green signals health: primary actions, live status, positive trends. Amber is fiscal (IVA/IGTF/SENIAT chips) and warning; red is alarm and destructive actions only. Keep the jobs separate.

rules.name: The Live-Moment Rule
rules.body: One authored moment per page: the hero count-up and the pulsing live dot. New animations need a world reason; prefers-reduced-motion must always kill them to instant state.

dos: Do keep the console legible: body text on bg at >=4.5:1 in both themes; --text-faint #5b6d63 on light bg is 5.05:1.
Do use IBM Plex Mono with font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1, "zero" 1 for every monetary value, date, SKU, and table cell.
Do keep dark mode as the operations floor: #0b100d bg, #121b15 surfaces, live forest green accents.
Do label demo console data as Datos de muestra so the landing hero never reads as real inventory.
Do anchor every Spanish-facing surface in es-VE and write copy first, translate never.
Do keep the theme-init inline script before CSS in every layout so there is no dark/light flash.
donts: Don't use mono for prose or labels — it is fiscal/data figures only.
Don't put a kicker, eyebrow, or section number above a heading.
Don't use hard offset shadows (4px 4px 0) — depth is soft shadows or nothing.
Don't use gradient text, glass, or backdrop-filter as decoration.
Don't invent extra authored animations; the count-up and live pulse are the world's motion.
Don't make red anything but alarm: buttons, badges, and messages that destroy or error.

Don't close the open product decisions from PRODUCT.md (final OSS license, role model, sucursales, inventory costing, direct SENIAT integration, offline depth, legacy importers, cloud pricing, tenant identification) by inventing UI for them.
